reviewer: Codex, personal complete-final-answer read; no paid judge
primary_route: Two protein-generation routes, lipid reconstitution, electrical/structural pores and cell structure-function bridge; conditional cofactor arm.

checks.reason: No explicit pre-execution consultation and transfer check of prior primary Methods, supplements or validated protocols; local validation and acknowledging absent packet methods do not by themselves satisfy this action.

The cleavage mixture central to the two-source comparison lacks active-caspase-alone/matched carryover controls; dead enzyme or uncleavable substrate is not an equivalent control for membrane activity of the active preparation. Cellular mutant specificity also lacks an explicit preserved-folding gate.

Core protein preparation/cleavage and lipid formulation/buffer conditions remain unresolved lists rather than a quantitative preparation-to-intervention workflow or a concrete source/calibration-to-setting procedure. Proposed protein concentration series alone does not specify the essential reconstitution.

Background and leakage threshold exist, but no explicit free-dye-plus-protein recovery/interference control or electrical noise-to-event acceptance procedure validates the central combined measurements.

Independent preparations and a pilot are recognized, but no quantitative power/precision target with an effect/variance-to-sample-size decision is supplied; a proposed three/six-preparation floor is not a justified confirmatory sample size.
Technical stops exist, but assigned preparation/trace denominators, attrition and a finite repeat/confirmatory stopping rule are absent.

The main contrast and model are named, but model assumptions/diagnostics and a fully specified uncertainty/multiplicity procedure for the panel are incomplete. Naming a mixed model is not sufficient execution detail.
A concentration/lipid/time range is proposed without a bounded ladder or concrete derivation of bounds, an objective selection criterion and a lock before independent confirmation.
Troubleshooting does not explicitly delimit permitted changes, refreeze the revised procedure and require fresh independent confirmation after such changes.

checks.quote: a distinct host component executes membrane injury
checks.reason: Pure-negative/native-positive, fraction restoration and cellular necessity cannot distinguish a host executor from a regulator enabling GSDMD. The stated positive M2 conclusion is stronger than its decision rule; charge this conditional branch once.
No complete raw-unit-to-output audit trail with sample identifiers, exact analysis versions/settings and preserved failed/excluded runs is specified.

The packet does not report full-length tolerance or establish NT necessity-and-sufficiency in the exact terms asserted as packet evidence. CT restraint is a plausible hypothesis rather than a supplied observation.

explanation_reason: Broadly correct direct-pore program, with weak execution/calibration, source overstatement and a non-identifying conditional executor inference.
historical_match_reason: The positive direct-pore branch supplies all five matching components, including independent NT production, pure membranes, electrical and structural corroboration and a cell mutant bridge. The separate cofactor branch and cleavage-mixture controls require correction and lower Q2; the independently expressed NT plus orthogonal pore branch remains capable of the historical finding.
